```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Url;
use App\Models\User;

Route::apiResource('urls', UrlController::class);
Route::apiResource('users', UserController::class);

```

This code snippet defines two apiResource routes for the Url and User models. Each route is mapped to a respective controller method. The `ApiResource` middleware automatically generates CRUD API routes based on the model's attributes.
